Moving the chat box out of order is possible but you will break a few things currently. Problem is the box containing the chat (and really, every box in the sidebar) does not have a unique identifier. If you try to target it using the CSS nth-of-type selector, you will break the sidebar on comment pages because the number and order of sidebar boxes is different from the front page of your subverse.

This needs some work on the back end to make styling easier first.

If you really want to try, the key is to make the element you want to move out of order absolute positioned, and its parent element relative positioned. Rough example:

.side {
 position: relative;
}
.side > .spacer:nth-of-type(6) {
 position: absolute;
 top: 0;
 left: 0;
}

That will position the 6th <div> element of class “spacer” (which happens to contain the chat box) at the top of the sidebar. I don’t recommend doing this as it will break the positioning of every other element. And it will break comment pages as mentioned. And it will break further if the HTML of the sidebar changes (e.g. due to updates to the Voat software).
